title: Wheat export single desk abolished
summary: From 1 July 2008 accredited exporters could export bulk wheat, ending AWB's single desk.

commenced.what: Accreditation scheme replaced the single desk

direction_rationale: Ending the statutory export monopoly lets several exporters compete for growers' grain.
comparison: Other grains not covered by the single desk
notes: The Port Terminal Access (Bulk Wheat) Code followed on 30 September 2014.
